title: Stereotactic body radiation therapy on Prostate with or without Androgen deprivation therapy, a phase III randomized controlled trial (SPA Trial)
official: Stereotactic body radiation therapy on Prostate with or without Androgen deprivation therapy, a phase III randomized controlled trial (SPA Trial)
summary: Main objective: To determinate if there is improvement in biochemical Disease Free Survival (bDFS) in patients treated with SBRT+ADT versus SBRT alone.

interventions.name: DECAPEPTYL 22,5 mg / 2ml - Polvere e solvente per sospensione iniettabile a rilascio prolungato

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. •	Age 18-80 years old.
2. •	Prostate Volume less than 100cc
3. •	PSA must be dosed maximum 60 days before randomization
4. •	No pathologic lymph nodes and distant metastasis on PET scan (fluorocholine or fluoroPSMA- galliumPSMA ) or CT scan+bone scan.
5. •	Histological confirmation of prostate acinar adenocarcinoma with a minimum of 10 biopsy cores taken
6. •	Prostate protocol MRI for local staging
7. •	Patients belonging to intermediate unfavorable group according to the D’Amico/NCCN risk group classification: o	-Grade group 3 or/and o	-2-3 risk factors for intermediate category (PSA 10-20 ng/ml/ Grade group 2-3/ cT2b-cT2c) or/and o	-biopsy cores positive ≥50%
8. •	Patients belonging to a subclass of high risk group according to the D’Amico/NCCN risk group classification: o	-ISUP group 4 (GS 4+4, excluding 3+5 and 5+3) or o	-cT3a stage or o	PSA>20 ng/ml
9. •	Eastern Coooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) PS 0-2
10. •	Ability of the patient to understand and sign a written informed consent document
11. •	Ability and Willingness to comply with patients reported outcome questionnaires schedule during the study time
12. •	IPSS 0-15
Exclusion criteria:
1. •	History of Malignant tumors in the previous 2 years excluding non melanoma cancers of the skin. If a patient presents an anamnesis of malignancy (excluding non melanoma skin cancers) it must be free from disease since 24 months at the time of enrollement. Patients affected by hematologic tumors in clinical-radiologic remission since at least 5 years after treatment or after follow-up only for which the prognosis is more than 10 years could be included in the trial after heamtologic consultation clearly declaring the prognosis. (chronic leucemia, phollicolar lymphoma, myelodisplastic syndromes).
2. •	Controindication or hypersensitivity to the use of Triptoreline
3. •	5alpha reductase inhibitors not discontinued 4 weeks prior to randomization
4. •	History of bone fractures and fall
5. •	Risk factors for abnormal heart rhythms or QT prolongation.
6. •	Use of concomitant medications that prolong the QT/QTc interval
7. •	Previous prostate surgery other than TURP (at least 6 weeks prior to start of SBRT).
8. •	Previous pelvic RT
9. •	Prior androgen deprivation therapy (excluding 5alpha reductase inhibitors)
10. •	Any prior active treatment for prostate cancer; patients on previous active surveillance are eligible if inclusion criteria are met
11. •	Active severe inflammatory bowel disease
12. •	Bilateral hip prothesis or any implant that could seriously interfere with dosimetric calculations
13. •	Age >80 years.
14. •	cT4a, cT3b or pelvic lymph node involvement
